product_gap.invariant: Every companion-authored user-visible desktop publication must pass a surface-specific final admission immediately before publication.

call_registry.rationale: CallRegistry is host-owned, keyed by authenticated plugin id plus host request id, preserves Origin(kind, ref), and deliberately retains finished records for 10 seconds because push_message rides a separate uplink and may arrive after the call reply.

capability_gate.rationale: MESSAGE_PUSH already reaches capability_gate while the authenticated plugin id and parent request id are both available; registry.lookup therefore provides the trusted origin without a new store.

message_routing.rationale: The authenticated host already overwrites plugin_id and strips _rpc_parent_request_id immediately before forwarding. The same boundary can overwrite one bounded host-only origin-kind field so plugin payloads cannot forge solicitation.

reply_quiet_gate.rationale: Existing _private_reply_output_blocked is the whole-reply explicit-quiet authority and must gate even user-solicited plugin-visible output.

interruptibility_gate.rationale: Existing _proactive_interruptibility_block_reason already rechecks latest ActivitySnapshot plus on-demand Windows QUNS immediately before nonessential desktop delivery.

rules: explicit quiet blocks every companion-authored plugin chat/HUD publication
trusted user-bound origins use the solicited floor after explicit-quiet admission and are not reclassified as ambient proactive output merely because the owner is coding or gaming
run/system/plugin_self/unknown use the existing final proactive interruptibility recheck before direct chat/HUD publication
missing or expired attribution fails conservative as plugin_self/nonessential
the plugin-supplied metadata object is never trusted for origin classification
html_card close is cleanup/withdrawal rather than new companion-authored publication and must remain deliverable even when create/update is blocked

broader_external.rationale: AIRI has notification/event delivery patterns but cannot gate N.E.K.O's existing direct sinks without replacing the frozen Companion Kernel.

rejected: new delivery router or notification daemon
calling prepare_proactive_delivery for every plugin output because it would claim/rotate proactive ownership and misclassify user-solicited tool/UI results

implementation_shape.host_origin_field: bounded host-only top-level field overwritten at authenticated MESSAGE_PUSH routing
implementation_shape.final_gate: reuse 0006 explicit quiet + 0009 latest interruptibility helpers at character_runtime direct chat/HUD sinks and plugin_cards create/update; card close bypasses admission as cleanup
implementation_shape.callback_behavior: native respond/passive/silent callback routing remains unchanged; only direct user-visible plugin parts gain final admission

retirement_condition: Remove the 0009 extension when pinned N.E.K.O natively carries trustworthy invocation origin to plugin-visible publication and routes direct plugin chat/HUD/desktop-notification sinks through equivalent surface-specific final admission; the same regressions must pass with the private extension removed.
required_acceptance: forged plugin origin is overwritten by authenticated host classification
live/recent call-registry attribution survives asynchronous push ordering
user-bound chat_tool/chat_hook/ui_action output is not ambient-blocked after explicit-quiet passes
plugin_self/system/run/unknown output is blocked by latest gaming/QUNS/focused-work/user-engaged states according to existing proactive floor
explicit quiet blocks both solicited and unsolicited plugin chat/HUD
plugin html_card create/update uses the same final floor while AgentHUD close remains deliverable as cleanup
blocked direct chat also prevents its paired HUD publication without altering native callback/outbox behavior
agent/** push applies the full 10-patch chain and runs focused regressions

scope_exclusions.plugin_ui_action_effects: media_play_url, allowlist changes and jukebox_control are execution/effect paths, not companion-authored publication; they remain under plugin capability/effect correctness rather than speech/delivery-floor policy
